findings.passage: “Stopping the scourge of gun violence will take action on the part of everyone, and I’m pleased that the ISO voted to advance a key step to prevent the next tragedy. American Express, Mastercard, Visa and other credit card companies now have a responsibility to implement the new merchant category code, so that financial institutions can do their part to flag suspicious activity and save lives.
findings.note: As NYC comptroller, he welcomed approval of a card-industry code for gun and ammunition stores and said card companies should use it to flag suspicious purchases.
subjects: general statement on gun violence prevention
